priorityList: Start from Stealth and cast Garrote.
Maintain Garrote, casting from Vanish when possible (ideally before every Deathmark).
Maintain Rupture with 5 or more Combo Points.
Activate Deathmark on cooldown, ideally alongside DPS potions and on-use trinkets.
Use Kingsbane on cooldown and sync it with Deathmark.
Refresh Improved Garrote by casting Garrote again immediately after starting the Kingsbane window.
Cast Envenom with 5 or more Combo Points.
Cast Ambush to generate Combo Points whenever usable via Blindside procs.
Cast Mutilate to generate Combo Points as your primary builder.
Use Thistle Tea alongside Kingsbane to avoid overcapping charges.
Chain Envenom casts by refreshing the buff while it is still active and within the Pandemic window (30% or less duration remaining).
Maintain Garrote on the target at all times.
Maintain Rupture with 5 or more Combo Points.
Cast Deathmark on cooldown.
Cast Kingsbane on cooldown, ideally synced with Deathmark and Shiv windows.
Cast Shiv during Kingsbane to maximize Nature damage amplification.
Cast Envenom with 5 or more Combo Points to maximize Envenom buff uptime and trigger Hand of Fate coin flips.
Cast Vanish on cooldown to apply an empowered Garrote.
Cast Ambush when Blindside procs.
